items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Yeah. Oh, that's Montague. INTERVIEWEE: Sidney Montague. Standing there. That's Sidney Montague.

ctx.x: Sidney Montague. Standing there. That's Sidney Montague. And, uh... This fellow looks like, uh, Israel Gorman if I'm... Might be. No, that's not Israel. Israel over here. Here's Israel Gorman. See him right in front. Right here. Right there, yeah. Yeah. Now here's, uh... This fellow, he's away. Mitchell, they call him. He played Clarinet in there, too. He's away now. Now here's, uh, Sam Lee right behind me. I'm in front and Sam trying to peep over.
Yeah, trying to peep through. Two heads, the heads, the heads, the heads. Yeah. Yeah. Wait a minute. We passed one standing up there, Manuel. Who's that? Behind this...

items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] so I was trying to think. Yeah, it looks like Sa-ee all right.

so I was trying to think. Yeah, it looks like Sa-ee all right. He looks bigger then than he is now.
Remember the fella that's called Battle Axe? That's him right there. He heard the name on guitar.
